messages.content:
You are an experienced UK building control surveyor. Answer the question about the work item
in the JSON state. Choose exactly one label:
- not_notifiable: No Building Regulations notice needed: not building work (reg 3), only Schedule 4 work, or an exempt building (reg 9, Schedule 2).
- competent_person_scheme: Notifiable work listed in Schedule 3: a registered competent person can self-certify it (reg 12(6)(a)); otherwise a building notice is needed.
- building_notice_or_full_plans: Building work not covered by Schedules 3 or 4: a building notice or a full plans application to building control (reg 12(2)).
- full_plans_required: Building work that must have a full plans application: the Fire Safety Order applies to the building (reg 12(3)), it fronts a private street (12(4)), or H4 applies (building over or near a sewer, 12(5)).
Reply with JSON only: {"label": "<one label>", "probabilities": {"<label>": <0..1>, ...}} with a
probability for every label, summing to 1.

Under the Building Regulations 2010 in England, which notification route applies to this work item if it is carried out on its own in the building described?

specialist process lighting);fixed systems for heating, hot water, air conditioning or mechanical ventilation; orany combination of systems of the kinds referred to in paragraph (a) or (b); “flat” of the Green Deal Framework Regulations; “green deal property” has the meaning given in section 12(5)(b) of the Energy Act 2011;“height” means the height of the building measured from the mean level of the ground adjoining the outside of the external walls of the building to the level of half the vertical height of the roof of the building, or to the top of the walls or of the parapet, if any, whichever is the higher; “higher-risk building” has the meaning given in regulation 3 of the Building Safety (Description of Higher-Risk Building) (Design and Construction Phase) (Wales) Regulations 2023; “higher-risk building work” means any work relating to higher-risk building or a proposed higher-risk building, including—any work relating to a building that is not a higher-risk building that causes it to become such a building, andany work relating to a higher-risk building that causes it to cease to be such a building.“independent access” means, in relation to a part of a building section 47 of the Act ;“institution” means an institution (whether described as a hospital, home, school or other similar establishment) which is used as living accommodation for, or for the persons sleep on the premises;“low voltage” means voltage not exceeding—in relation to alternating current, 1000 volts between conductors or 600 volts between conductors and earth; orin relation to including where a domestic client assigns themselves to perform the duties of a principal contractor under these Regulations; “principal designer” means—the designer appointed under regulation 11U decorative finishes, and “renovate” shall be construed accordingly;“room for residential purposes” means a room, or a suite of rooms, which is not a dwelling-house or a flat and which is used by one or more persons to live and sleep and includes a room in a hostel, an hotel, a boarding house, a hall of residence or a residential home, but does not include a room in a hospital, or other similar establishment, used for patient accommodation;“shop” includes premises—used for the sale to members of the public of food or drink for consumption on or off the premises,used for retail sales by auction to members of the public,used by members of the public as a barber or hairdresser, or for the hiring of any item, andwhere members of the public may take goods for repair or other treatment;“softened wholesome water” means water which would be regarded as wholesome for the purposes of regulations made under section 67 of the Water Industry Act 1991 (standards of wholesomeness) softener or water softening process which reduces the concentrations of calcium and magnesium ; “sole contractor” means a person fulfilling the duties of the principal contractor by virtue of electricity generation” means a system that produces electricity and has a direct electrical connection to the building in question...."}]}

message.reasoning: I'm working through Schedule 4 of the electrical regulations — adding light points to existing circuits outside special locations like bathrooms isn't notifiable, but I need to think about how this applies when it's part of a larger whole-house renovation project.
